title: Reflow vs Repaint: Know the Difference

scenes.line1: Why does changing width slow pages?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why changing an element's width can slow down your web page? Is it a reflow or a repaint?

scenes.label: Reflow
scenes.sub: Recalculates layout and geometry of elements.
scenes.say: Reflow means the browser recalculates the layout and geometry of elements. It's a heavy operation.

scenes.label: Repaint
scenes.say: Repaint updates the pixels on the screen, like color changes, but doesn't affect layout.
Changing width triggers reflow. Changing background color triggers repaint. Layout changes are always more expensive.

scenes.question: Does changing color cause reflow?
scenes.right: No, it only triggers repaint. Layout stays the same.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Does changing color cause a reflow? No, it only triggers repaint. Layout stays the same.
